questions.question: The wedding gown (a)/ looked decently (b)/ despite being (c)/ studded with jewels.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'decent' instead of 'decently'. Explanation:- kyunki 'looked' yahan linking verb hai aur linking verb ke baad adjective ka use hota hai, aur 'decently' adverb hota hai aur 'decent' adjective. Note:- 'look' verb ka matlab jab 'dekhna' hota hai tab yeh verb action verb hoti hai. Jab look verb ka matlab 'dikhaayi padna' hota hai tab yeh linking verb hoti hai. Eg:-(a) She is looking at me (action verb) (b) She looks sad (linking verb)

questions.question: The recently hike (a)/ in the price of petroleum products (b)/ will hit (c)/ household budgets severely.(d)
questions.solution: use 'recent' instead of 'recently'. Explanation:- yahan 'hike' noun hai aur noun ke pehle adjective ka use kiya jaata hai 'recently' adverb hota hai aur 'recent' adjective hota hai.

questions.question: None can (a)/ believe that (b)/ Ramesh is happier (c)/ than grieved to know it.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'more happy' in place of 'happier'. Explanation:- jab ek hi person ki do qualities ka aapas mein comparison hota hai, toh comparative degree 'er' wale structure se nahi 'more' wale structure se banayi jaati hai, isliye 'more happy' sahi hoga.

questions.question: If he wants (a)/ farther information, (b)/send him (c)/ to me.(d)
questions.solution: use 'further' instead of 'farther'. Explanation:- 'farther' ka use distance ko refer karne ke liye kiya jaata hai jabki 'further' ka use more/addition ko refer karne ke liye kiya jaata hai. Toh additional information ki baat karni hai, isliye 'further' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Your comment (a)/ on this issue (b)/ is more right (c)/ and I am with you all along the way.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'more' before 'right'. Explanation:- kyunki 'right' adjective apne aap mein absolute hota hai, isliye isko qualify karne ke liye koi adverb nahi lagega.

questions.question: Sachin Tendulkar is the humblest (a)/ and prolific (b)/ cricket player in the history of cricket.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'the most prolific' in place of 'prolific'. Explanation:- Kyunki jab do adjective 'and' conjuction se jode jaate hain toh dono same degree me likhe jaate hai. Kyunki 'the humblest' superlative degree hai, isliye 'prolific' ke sath 'the most' lagake superlative degree mein likhenge.

questions.question: It was really surprising (a)/ that the two bosom friends fought (b)/ over such a triviale matter (c)/ and stopped all communications with each other.(d)
questions.solution: use 'trivial' instead of 'triviale'. Explanation:- because the correct word is 'trivial' which means having little value or importance. Note:- Iss type ke spelling based error waise toh kam aate hain lekin kabhi kabhi aa jaate hain.

questions.question: Ramesh is smarter (a)/ enough to get (b)/ selected for this (c)/ post, without any recommendations.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'smart' in place of 'smarter'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan Ramesh ka kisi aur se comparison nahi karna hai isliye comparative degree ka use nahi hoga balki positive degree 'smart' ka use hoga. Yahan meaning dena hai Ramesh 'enough smart' hai.

questions.question: The management is not perturbed about appointing (a)/ someone who is knowledgeable but is more inclined (b)/ towards filling the position with a person (c)/ who will be obsequous and will dance to their tunes.(d)
questions.solution: use 'obsequious' instead of 'obsequous'. Explanation:- because the correct word is 'obsequious' which means too eager to praise or obey someone aur (d) part me 'their' ki jagah par 'Its' bhi hoga. Kyunki yeh managment ke liye aaya hai. Note:- Iss type ke spelling based questions exam me kabhi kbhar aa jaate hain.

questions.question: Of the three, women, wine and songs,(a)/ the former (b)/ brought about his ruin.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'first' in place of 'former'. Explanation:- Kyunki yahan teen mein se sabse pehle waale ki baat karni hai isliye 'first' ka use hoga 'former' word ka use hum tab karte hain jab do mein se pehle ki baat kehna hota hai.

questions.question: The Dussehra celebrations (a)/ in Mysore (b)/ this year (c)/ are grandest than in any other part of the state.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'grander than those' in place of 'Grandest than'. Explanation:- kyunki 'than' conjunction se pata chal raha hai ki yahan comparative degree lagani hai. Note:- Yahan Mysore mein ho rahe dussehra celebration ka comparison baaki poore state mein ho rahe dussehra celebration se karna hai, but yahan superlative Degree ka use nahi hoga kyunki 'than' bhi laga hai aur 'other' bhi laga hai, aur jaisa ki aapko class mein padhaya gaya hai comparative Degree laga kar bhi kisi ek ka comparision ek se zyada cheezon ke sath kiya jaa sakta hai.

questions.question: No less than thousands of spectators are (a)/ waiting for Dhoni to come out (b)/ in the field and play his (c)/ masterful stroke.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'fewer' in place of 'less'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'less' little ki comparative degree hai jiska use generally uncountable nouns ke sath hota hai but yha aage likhe 'thousands of spectators' se pata chal raha hai ki yeh countable hai plural hai isliye yahan 'no fewer than' ka use hoga. kyuki 'fewer' comparative degree hain 'few' ki jiska use countable nouns ke sath hota hai.

questions.question: The weather (a)/ is much (b)/ more warmer (c)/ than it was a few days before.(d)
questions.solution: remove 'more' before 'warmer'. Explanation:- 'Warmer' se pehle likha gaya 'more' hatana padega kyunki 'warmer' already comparative Degree hai iske sath 'more' laga kar ise aur comparative banane ki zarurat nahi hai. Agar 'intensity' hi badhaani ki baat hai toh uske liye 'much' already laga hua hai. Isliye yahan 'more' ko hatana padega.

questions.question: While you are in Agra, (a)/ you must not miss (b)/ seeing the TajMahal, (c)/ because it is a worth seeing monument.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'monument worth seeing' in place of 'worth seeing monument'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'worth + V1 + ing' se jab adjective banate hain to ing wala structure humesha 'worth' ke baad hi lagana hota hai yeh structure aapko yaad hi karna hi. Eg:- It is a movie worth watching. It is a place worth visiting.

questions.question: Little support from (a)/ your parents would have (b)/ placed you on the top (c)/ of the world for sure.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'a little' instead of 'little'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'a little' ka matlab hota hai 'Thoda' aur 'little' ka matlab hota hai 'na ke barabar' aur yahan sentence ka meaning positive hai. Yahan meaning yeh hai ki parents se mili hui thodi si bhi support tumhe pakka duniya ke top tak pahuncha deti hai. Yahan 'na ke barabar' support wala meaning nahi dena hai, isliye 'a little' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Economists have declared that 2020 graduates (a)/ will face the worse job depression (b)/since the Great Depression (c)/ because of the COVID-19 pandemic.(d)
questions.solution: use 'worst' instead of 'worse'. Explanation:- kyunki 'worse' comparative degree hoti hai aur yahan superlative degree ki need hai kyunki yahan 2020 ke depression ka comparison 'great depression' se lekar ab tak duniya mein aaye saare depression se karna hai. Isliye yahan 'worst' sahi hoga. Note:- depression ka matlab hota hai bahut bada recession

questions.question: It is well known (a)/ that Mrs. Indira Gandhi (b)/ was the first politician (c)/ of her time.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'foremost' in place of 'first'. Explanation:- kyunki 'first' ka matlab hota hai 'sabse pehla' aur foremost ka matlab hota hai 'us time me sabse mashoor' toh yahan sentence ke meaning ke according 'foremost' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Parul is (a)/ ten years (b)/ elder than (c)/ her sibling.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'elder to' instead of 'elder than'. Explanation:-Zyadatar books mein iss question ka Answer aapko 'elder' ke baad 'to' lagana milega isliye exam me aapko bhi 'elder' ke baad 'to' hi manna padega but agar sahi grammar ki baat karen toh 'elder' word aise linking verb ke baad laga kar Comparison ke liye use nahi hota Elder word sirf noun ke pehle likha jaa sakta hai. Eg:- She is my elder sister. Agar 'pure grammar' ki baat karen toh yahan par sahi Answer hona chahiye tha 'older than' lekin ab saari books mein bhi galat likha hai toh obviously competitive exams etc. mein aap bhi 'elder to' hi karke aaiyega.

questions.question: Bharatpur is transforming into (a)/ India's most fastest growing bird sanctuary (b)/ attracting thousands of rare migratory birds (c)/ from Europe and Siberia.(d)
questions.solution: remove 'most' before 'fastest'. Explanation:- Kyunki 'fastest' apne aap me superlative degree hai aur uske sath 'most' laga kar use aur superlative banane ki zarurat nahi hai, fir bhi agar intensity badhani hi ho toh 'by far the fastest' ya 'much the fastest' ka use kar sakte hain.

questions.question: Do you earn (a)/ so much to (b)/ make both (c)/ ends meet?(d)
questions.solution: use 'enough' instead of 'so much'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan hum kehna chahte hain ki 'kya aap paryapt paisa kamate hai?' Isliye 'enough' ka use hoga aur 'so' ke sath generally 'that' ka pair banta hai isliye bhi yahan 'so' nahi aa payega. Eg:-. He is so rich that he can buy any car.

questions.question: This book is (a)/ as good, if (b)/ not better than that book.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'as good as' in place of 'as good'. Explanation:- kyunki 'as good as' yahan par ek simile hai jise poora hi likha jayega. Iss sentence ka asli structure yeh hai 'This book is as good as that book is if it is not better than that book' yahan iska meaning yeh hai ki 'yeh kitaab utni hi achchi hai jitni veh kitaab hai agar usse zyada achchi nahi hai toh' inhi dono books ka do baar comparison hai isliye 'subject + verb' understood ho rhe hain but simile ek conjunction ka kaam karti hai veh poori hi likhi jayegi.

questions.question: He was not able (a)/ to give (b)/ many time (c)/to his research.(d)
questions.solution: use 'much' instead of 'many'. Explanation:- kyunki time ek uncountable noun hai iske sath 'many' ka use nahi kiya jaa sakta isliye 'much' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Hari lost (a)/ a hundred rupees note (b)/ yesterday.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'rupee' in place of 'rupees'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'hundred rupees' ye phrase 'note' noun ke liye adjective ki tarah se kaam kar rha hai isliye iska plural nahi kiya jaayega

questions.question: Death is (a)/ more preferable (b)/ to (c)/ dishonor.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'more'. Explanation:- kyunki 'preferable' apne aap me hi comparison ko dikhata hai uske sath 'more' laga kar usse comparative karne ki jarurat nahi hai.

questions.question: All these boys (a)/ have come to college (b)/ without few knowledge (c)/ of English.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'any' instead of 'few'. Explanation:-kyunki 'knowledge' noun uncountable hota hai aur 'few' countable ke liye lagta hai isliye 'few' toh aa nahi sakta dusri baat yahan par 'little' bhi nahi aa sakta kyunki 'without' laga hone ki wajah se meaning already negative ho chuka hai. Yahan par ek neutral word lagana padega jo naa positive ho naa hi negative ho isliye meaning ke according yahan 'any' word ka use kiya jayega

questions.question: The militants (a)/ entered the palace (b)/ from the utmost gate (c)/ with guns hidden in their clothes.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'outermost' in place of 'utmost'. Explanation:- 'Outermost' ka matlab hota hai 'sabse bahar wala' aur 'utmost' ka matlab hota hai 'greatest', toh sentence ke according 'outermost' sahi hoga. Eg:-. This is a matter of utmost importance.

questions.question: The wedding reception (a)/will be hosted (b)/ in Mumbai (c)/ at a late date.(d)
questions.solution: use 'later date' instead of 'late date'. Explanation:- 'late' ki jagah 'later' aayega kyunki 'late' ka use 'der ho jaana' wala meaning ke liye aata hai aur 'later' ka use 'baad waale time' ko refer karne ke liye aata hai. Sentence ka matlab 'wedding reception host hoga baad waali date par', toh 'baad waali date' ki baat ho rahi hai, isliye yahan 'at a later date' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Gold is (a)/ the most (b)/ precious of (c)/ all other metals.(d)
questions.solution: Remove other. Explanation:- kyunki 'superlative degree ke case me exclude karne ki need nahi hoti. Iska matlab hee hota hai same category mein sabse accha, kyunki 'gold' bhi metal ka hissa hai, isliye yahan 'metal' se pehle 'other' nahi aayega.

questions.question: According to a recent study, (a)/ drinking green tea thrice a week (b)/ is associated with (c)/ a longest and healthy life.(d)
questions.solution: 'Longest and healthy' ki jagah par 'longer and healthier'. Explanation:- jab 'and' conjuction se do adjectives judte hain toh dono same degree me hone chahiye. Note:- Agar hum yahan 'longer and healthier' likhte toh aur better meaning aata kyunki hume yahan 'green tea naa peene walon' ka comparison 'green tea peene walon' se karna hai, isliye 'longer and heartier' dono comparative degree mein likhna better hai.

questions.question: Of the three cities, Mumbai, Delhi and Kolkata, (a)/ the latter is the (b)/ dirtiest.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'last' in place of 'latter'. Explanation:- kyunki do se zyada options mein se last wale ko refer karne ke liye 'last' word ka use hota hai, do mein se baad wale ko refer krne ke liye 'latter' ka use hota hai.

questions.question: You must make (a)/ a choice immediately (b)/ because there is (c)/ few time left.(d)
questions.solution: use 'little' instead of 'few'. Explanation:-kyunki 'few' ka use countable noun ke sath kiya jaata hai aur 'time' ek uncountable noun hai isliye 'little' ka use hoga.

questions.question: On entering the crowding room (a)/ I could not see one person (b)/ whom I knew.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'crowded' in place of 'crowding'. Explanation:- yeh concept present participle vs past participle ke use par based hain. Eg:-. 'Horrifying man' ka matlab 'Darawna aadmi' Or 'Horrified man' ka matlab 'dara hua aadmi'. 'Present participle' jab kisi noun ke liye lagaya jaata hai toh veh noun present participle mein ho rahe kaam ka 'doer' hota hai aur past participle jab kisi noun ke liye lagaya jaata hai toh veh noun past participle mein ho rahe kaam ka receiver hota hai. 'room' 'crowd' hone ka doer nahi hai balki receiver hai, isliye yahan past participle 'crowded' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The invited guests (a)/ preferred orange juice (b)/ than hot coffee (c)/ or chilled grapes.(d)
questions.solution: use 'to' instead of 'than'. Explanation:- kyunki 'senior, junior, prefer, preferable, prior, posterior, etc'. ke sath 'to' ka use kiya jaata hai 'than' ka nahi.

questions.question: The vacancy was filled (a)/ by a young scholar (b)/ who had an extensible knowledge of ancient art.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'extensive' in place of 'extensible'. Explanation:- 'extensible' ka matlab jisse badhaaya aur kheecha jaa sake aur jo extendable ho. Extensive ka matlab hota hai jo kisi bade area, range yaa comprehensive research ko cover kare. sentence ka matlab hai 'young scholar hai jisse kaafi vast knowledge hai ancient art ki', isliye yahan 'knowledge' ke sath 'extensive' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The shopkeeper said (a)/ that he would accept (b)/no less than three hundred rupees for the watch.(c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: Explanation:- time, value, weight and length ko dikhane waale words jab ek unit ki tarah kaam karte hai toh unhe uncountable ki tarah treat kiya jaata hai. Eg:-. 10 kilometers is a long distance to travel on foot. 10000 rupees is a very big amount for me.

questions.question: She is so vivacious (a)/ and expressive that she is a dear girl (b)/ to all of us.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: put 'dear' after 'girl'. Explanation:- 'To all of us' yeh phrase 'dear' adjective ko qualify karne ke liye aaya hai isliye sentence mein 'ambiguity' ko hatane ke liye 'dear' adjective ko iske pehle likhna padega. Jisse matlab hoga 'ladki laadli hai hum sabki'.

questions.question: The both (a)/ children go (b)/ to the (c)/ same school.(d)
questions.solution: use 'both the' instead of 'the both'. Explanation:- kyunki 'all' aur 'both' ye do ese adjective hote hain jinke baad article yaa koi aur possessive adjective etc. ka use kiya jaata hai. Eg:-. All the boys / Both the boys / All my friends / Both my friends. Note:- yeh baat aapko yaad hi karni hai.

questions.question: Unless it is accepted to both the parties, an (a)/ arbitrator would be of no (b)/ use to settle this dispute.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'acceptable' in place of 'accepted'. Explanation:- Accepted - 'Jise accept kar liya gaya ho.' Acceptable - 'Jise accept kiya jaa sake.' Agar 'it is accepted' ka use karenge toh yeh passive structure ho jayega aur aage 'by+doer' jaise kuch nahi likha isliye meaning ke according aur structure ke according 'it is accepted' galat ho jayega 'it is acceptable' se meaning and grammar dono theek rahenge.

questions.question: He likes to put (a)/ all the garbage (b)/ into a (c)/ black small bag.(d)
questions.solution: use 'small black bag' instead of 'black small bag'. Explanation:- kyunki kisi noun ke pehle use kiye jaane waale qualitative adjectives ka order opinion-Size-Age-Shape-Colour-Origin-Material hota hai, isliye 'small black bag' sequence sahi hoga.

questions.question: She has lost (a)/ the watch very (b)/ gifted by (c)/ her boyfriend.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'the very watch' in place of 'the watch very'. Explanation:- 'very' yahan emphatic adjective ki tarah se kaam kar rha hai 'watch' ke liye, isliye iski position 'watch' noun se pehle hogi.

questions.question: I had a hard time (a)/ paying the driver (b)/ as I had (c)/ only hundreds rupee note.(d)
questions.solution: Explanation:- only hundred rupees note ki jagah inme se koi ek use karenge. only one hundred rupee note. (Sirf ek 100 rupees ka note) only one hundred rupees(Sirf 100 rupees) only hundred rupee notes(Sirf 100-100 rupees wale note)

questions.question: When I was walking (a)/ along the bank of the river, (b)/ I saw an asleep man (c)/ in rags and tatters.(d)
questions.solution: Use 'I saw a man who was asleep' in place of 'I saw an asleep man'. Explanation:- kyunki 'asleep' ek aisa adjective hai jo ki noun se pehle nahi lagaya jaata balki iska use 'predicatively' yaani linking verb ke baad likh kar kiya jaata hai, isliye isse 'man' ke liye adjectival clause 'who was asleep' banake likhenge.

questions.question: Don't worry, (a)/ there is less time (b)/ for the train to arrive.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'less' with 'some/enough/a little'. Explanation:- yahan koi comparison nahi ho raha isliye 'less' ka use nahi hoga. Toh sahi meaning ke liye inme se koi bhi word laga sakte hain. some time (thoda time), enough time (Paryapt time), a little time (thoda time). Note:- yahan 'less' ki jagah 'little' ka use nahi ho sakta kyunki sentence ke shuru mein 'don't worry' likha hai jisse pta chal raha hai ki hum aage positive meaning dena chahte hain. 'little' laga dene se meaning ho jayega ki 'na ke barabar time bacha hai'. 'few' countable noun ke liye aata hai.

questions.question: The food tasted deliciously (a)/ and all present in the party (b)/ enjoyed it to their full.(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: Use 'delicious' in place of 'deliciously'. Explanation:- kyunki 'taste' ek linking verb ki tarah se kaam kar rahi hai isliye uske baad koi adverb nahi balki adjective ka use kiya jayega. 'deliciously' adverb hota hai aur 'delicious' adjective.

questions.question: He lost (a)/ all his (b)/ hardly earned money.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'hard' instead of 'hardly'. Explanation:- 'Hardly' (adv)(naa ke barabar)- only just; almost not; 'Hard' (adv) (mehenat se/zor se)- needing or using a lot of physical or mental, toh sahi meaning ke liye 'hard earned money' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Everything will be done (a)/ to bring (b)/ the responsible people to justice.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'people responsible' in place of 'responsible people'. Explanation:- sentence mein 'responsible' 'people' ke baad aayega kyunki 'noun' ke pehle responsible positive meaning ke liye aata hai aur noun ke baad negative meaning ke liye, 'responsible people' ka matlab 'jimmedar log' aur 'people responsible' ka matlab 'log kisi cheez ke liye jimmedar', sentence mein kehna hai 'log justice ke liye jimmedar' negative meaning dena hai, isliye 'people responsible' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She ran so fastly (a)/ that I could (b)/ not overtake her.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: use 'fast' instead of 'fastly'. Explanation:- kyunki 'fastly' koi word nahi hota, correct word 'fast' hota hai chahe hume adjective banana ho yaa adverb banana ho word 'fast' hi use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: Even today (a)/ it is incredulous to think (b)/ that men have walked on the moon.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: Use 'incredible' in place of incredulous. Explanation:- 'incredible' (positive sense) (kuch itna accha yaa bada ho ki yakeen na ho ki ye sahi mein hai):- impossible or very difficult to believe, 'incredulous' (negative sense) (jo kisi cheez par shak kare):-not willing or not able to believe something, toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'incredible' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Platinum is (a)/ costlier than (b)/ any metal (c)/ found on earth.(d)
questions.solution: Replace 'Any metal' with 'any other metal'. Explanation:- kyunki jab ek noun ka comparison ek aise group se karna hota hai jiska wo khud ek part hota hai toh usse exclude karna padta hai, isliye yahan 'other' lagakar exclude karna padega.

questions.question: A skilful advertiser may be able to create (a)/ practically a monopoly for himself (b)/ not because his product is superior to (c)/ but because he has succeeded in inducing people to believe that it is.(d)
questions.solution: Remove 'to' after 'superior'. Explanation:- kyunki yahan 'to' preposition ke baad koi noun hi available nahi hai isliye yahan 'superior' ke baad 'to' ka use nahi hoga.

questions.question: Deepak said he would pack (a)/ few things he had (b)/ and vacate the hostel room (c)/ the next day.(d)
questions.solution: use 'the few' instead of 'few'. Explanation:- yahan meaning yeh hai ki wo apni thodi jitni cheezen hain wo pack karega aur hostel khali kar dega. 'whole quantity' ke liye 'the few', 'positive' meaning ke liye 'a few', naa ke barabar ke liye 'few' ka use karte hai. Note:- 'he had' se pehle "that" understood hai yahan 'the few things that he had=the few things he had'

questions.question: Although the toys (a)/ are altogether (b)/ in the cupboard (c)/ they are not properly arranged.(d)
questions.solution: use 'all together' instead of 'altogether'. Explanation:- 'Altogether' ka matlab 'in total' or 'completely'. 'All together' ka matlab 'with each other' (ek sath), toh meaning ke according 'all together' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Scientists have found (a)/ that life was creeping and crawling about the Earth (b)/ 1.5 billion years early than (c)/ previously thought.(d)
questions.solution: use 'earlier' instead of 'early'. Explanation:- kyunki 'early' positive degree hoti hai aur yahan 'than' se pata chal raha ki comparison karna hai, isliye comparative degree 'earlier' ka use hoga. Iss sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki scientist ne paaya hai ki life ki utpatti dharti par jo pehle anuman lagaya gaya tha usse 1.5 billion years pehle hi ho gayi thi.

questions.question: You should know (a)/ that the blind (b)/ leads a very difficult life.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'leads' with 'lead'. Explanation:- 'the blind' ka matlab hai saare blind people, 'the+adjective' common plural noun banata hai isliye inke sath plural verb ka use kiya jaata hai.

questions.question: I will give you (a)/my notes if you promise (b)/to return the same by Sunday.(c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the same' with 'them'. Explanation:- 'the same' ka use adjective ke roop mein kiya jaata hai par hume yahan pronoun ki zarurat hai jo 'notes' noun ko refer karega and 'to return' infinitive ka object banega. Eg:-. She is the same girl that we met in the restaurant.

questions.question: The photograph which (a)/ was taken by Rahul is (b)/ comparatively better than this one.(c)/ no error(d)
questions.solution: replace 'better' with 'good'. Explanation:- sab books mein ye rule maanke ki 'comparatively' ke sath adjective ki positive degree aati hai iska answer diya jata hai ki 'better' ki jagah 'good' aayega isliye exam mein apko bhi wahi karna padega but according to correct grammar 'comparatively' ko hataya jana chahiye.

questions.question: The stranger stood quietly for few moments.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'few' ka matlab (na ke brabar), 'the few' ka matlab (specific/ particular) and 'a few' ka matlab (kuch). yahan specific yaa negative ka koi hint nahi hai isliye meaning ke according 'a few' best option hai.

questions.question: We live in a populated country of 120 million people.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'populated' ( V2 of verb populate) ka matlab kisi area mein jaa kar rehna. 'Populous' (Adjective) :- wo area jahan bahut sare log rahte hai. Yahan country noun ke liye adjective ki requirement hai. Isliye 'populous' adjective aayega.

questions.question: This package is ideal for infant teenager who are just getting started with babysitting.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Infant - a baby, Teenager - 12 to 19 year age boy or girl, isliye Infant teenager jaisa koi term possible hi nhi hai. sentence mein teenagers ka kisi aur se inka comparison nahi hai isliye 'younger' and 'youngest' bhi sahi nahi hai. isliye 'young teenagers' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Between Raima and Saima, the former is intelligent, while the latter is beautiful.
questions.solution: Explanation:- latter - 2 cheezo mein se baad wala, later - fir kabhi/ baad mein (time). Yahan meaning ke according 'latter' sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: With tear eyes, she said goodbye to her dear friend.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan eyes ke liye adjective chahiye. tear up phrasal verb hai jiska matlab (faad dena). tearing - (ing form of verb tear) present participle. tearing eyes ka maltab (fati hui aakhne). teary adjective hota hai jiska matlab (filled with tears), toh meaning ke according sahi option 'teary eyes' hoga.

questions.question: The apple tree was loaded of fruit.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Trees pe lage fruits ke liye and person pe emotion burden yaa responsibilities etc ke liye loaded nahi laden ka use hota hai. isliye yahan 'laden with' ka use hoga.

questions.question: The money arrived when I (little) expected it.
options: The money arrived when I expected it.
The money arrived when I least expected it.
The money arrived when I less expected it.
The money arrived when I little expected it
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yeh adjective ki change of degree ka question hai. yahan little ki superlative degree likhni hai jo ki 'least' hoti hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
options: This is one of the most beautiful places in the area.
This is one of the more beautiful places in the area.
This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
This is a beautiful place in the area.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yeh adjective ki change of degree ka question hai yahan 'beautiful' ki superlative degree likhni hai jo ki 'most beautiful' hoti hai. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: David looks (old) than he really is.
options: David looks old than he really is.
David looks older than he really is.
David looks elder than he really is.
David looks elder from he really is.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yeh adjective ki change of degree ka question hai yahan 'old' ki comparative degree likhni hai jo ki older hoti hai. Isliye option B sahi hoga. Note :- 'elder' siblings ke liye aata hai. Yahan kisi sibling se comparison nhi hai khud se hi hai.

questions.question: Gel ingredients work well on waved, curled, relax and texture hair in the long run.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan 'hair' noun ke liye adjective ka use karna hai. or parallelism and meaning ke according saare past participle form mein use hue hai, isliye 'relaxed and textured' option A sahi hai.

questions.question: It has been my great misfortune to follow a speech more notable for its volume than for any sense.
options: to follow a speech much notable
to have being following a speech more notable
questions.solution: Explanation:- Iss sentence ka meaning yeh hai ki :- 'yeh meri badkismati thi ki maine ek aise speech suni jo apni length ke liye jada famous thi bajaaye ki koi sense ke liye. yahan speech ki length and sense ka comparison hai isliye yahan comparitive degree sahi lagi hai. Isliye option B 'no subsitution' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This is on far a best ice cream I have ever had.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'I have ever had' - jo aaj tak maine khai hai. Yaani iss ice cream ka comparison aaj tak khai sab ice-cream se hai isliye superlative degree lagegi. or superlative degree ki intensity badhane ke liye 'by far' ka use hota hai. Isliye 'by far the best' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: Robin has less marbles than George.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'than' se pata chal raha ki comparison ho raha hai isliye 'enough' and 'few' galat honge. 'less' uncountable ke liye aata hai but marbles countable hai isliye 'fewer' wala option D sahi hoga. Note - lower ka use isliye nahi hoga kyunki lower marbles = neeche marbles (meaning less), 'lower number of marbles' theek ho sakta tha but wo option mein nahi hai.

questions.question: One must care as for family members as possible.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Inn dono ke meanings ek hi hai bas structure ka difference hai:- 'One must care for family members as much as possible' = 'One must care as much for family members as possible'. Simile mein positive degree ka hi use hota hai isliye 'much' hi sahi hai 'more and most' nahi.

questions.question: This TV channel has a larger viewership from another channel.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Comparative degree 'larger' ke baad 'than' ka use hoga aur 'This Tv' channel ko group se exclude karne ke liye 'any other' ka use hoga. isliye 'than any other channel' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: This mango tree yields lot of mangoes every year.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'A lot of' :- quantitative adjective, 'A lot' - adverb of degree, 'Lot of' - wrong word, 'The lot of' - isme 'lot' noun hai. yahan 'mangoes' ke liye quantitative adjective chahiye, isliye 'a lot of' ka use hoga.

questions.question: You must start your work without some farther delay.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning dena hai 'bina koi bhi aur delay ke' isliye 'any further delay' ka use hoga. any - koi bhi, further - in addition to something.

questions.question: There is no need to make changes in many part of this sentence as it is grammatically correct.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence ke last mein dia hai 'as it is grammatically correct' isliye obviously sahi meaning yeh hoga ki ' kisi bhi part mein changes karne ki jarurat nahi hai', isliye 'in any part of' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Priya had strong enough to fight all odds and succeed in meeting her goals in life.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Sentence mein meaning ye dena hai ki 'Priya enough strong thi ladne ke liye..'. Kisi person ki koi quality bataane ke liye generally 'Subject + linking verb + Adjective(Subject complement)' structure ka use hota hai. isliye 'was strong' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Children need much of guidance in how to use the internet wisely and efficiently.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Much' ka use quantity show karne generally negative yaa interrogative mein kiya jata hai. Eg. There was too much traffic today. Yahan positive mein baat karni hai aur 'of' preposition bhi ek hint hai ki 'a lot of ' ka use hoga. Isliye 'a lot' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: You can find several kind of birds in the Mysore Zoo, Pelicans, Flamingos, Hornbills and Egrets.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'several' ke baad noun plural aata hai. Isliye 'several kinds' wala option A sahi hoga eg. several movies, several times etc. isliye 'several kinds of birds' ka use hoga.

questions.question: "Can you give me so many examples of subordinate clauses?", the teacher asked the class.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Some' ke sath 'many' yaa 'few' ka use nahi hota opposite meaning hone ki wajah se. Sentence ke meaning ke according 'teacher yahan students ko aur examples ke liye puch raha hai', isliye 'some more examples of' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Lenovo has launched ThinkPad XI Fold, the world's first foldable laptop which is claimed to be so durable as its other devices.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Simile mein positive degree adjective ka use hota hai aur conjunction chapter ke concept ke according 'so as' ka use sirf negative meaning ke liye hota hai yahan koi negative meaning nahi cahiye. isliye 'to be as durable as' simile wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Rahul thinks that this is quite the cheap restaurant.
questions.solution: Explanation- 'Such' ki tarah 'quite' ka use bhi emphasis daalne ke liye use hota hai. Eg. It is quite a small house. Structure:- quite + a/an + adjective + noun. Sentence mein bhi emphasise karna hai isliye 'quite a cheap' ka use hoga.

questions.question: He spends good deal of money on clothing.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'a lot of' ki tarah 'a good deal of' phrase bhi quantity dikhaane ke liye use kiya jata hai. Baki saare options yahan grammatically sahi nahi hain. Isliye option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The author is not well known. Little bit people have heard of him.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Little bit of' and 'a little bit of' ka use uncountable nouns ke liye hota hai jabki 'people' countable noun hai. Sentence ke shuru mein likha hai ki 'Author well known nahi hai' matlab 'naa ke barabar' log jaante honge, isliye 'few people' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: My mother looked at Sana and me with her mouth slight openly.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan 'mouth' noun ko qualify karna hai isliye 'open' adjective ka use hoga aur 'open' adjective ke liye 'slightly' adverb ka. isliye 'with her mouth slightly open' ka use hoga.

questions.question: Water and minerals presented to the soil are absorbed by the roots.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan meaning ye dena hai ki 'water and minerals jo soil mein present hote hain.' isliye yahan water and minerals' noun ke liye adjective ki jarurat hai kyunki verb toh 'are absorbed' hai. Presented (Past participle) lagane se meaning passive ho jayega:- water and minerals jo soil mein present kiye jate hain. yeh sahi meaning nahi hai isliye adjective 'present' ka use hoga. 'water and minerals present in the soil' sahi hoga. Note:- 'present' word ka parts of speech sentence ke according adjective and verb dono ho sakte hain

questions.question: Peterkin readjusted his hat and soon was listening to the conversation with as much interest as I was.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Interest' uncountable noun hai isliye iske sath 'many' ka use nahi hoga aur 'so as' ka use conjunction chapter ke concept ke according negative meaning ke liye hota hai. isliye 'as much interest as 'sahi use hua hai.

questions.question: It is much more difficult to judge oneself than to judge others.
questions.solution: Explanation:- yahan adjective ki requirement hai isliye 'difficult' ka use hoga. 'Difficult' adjective ko qualify karne ke liye adverb ki jarurat hai. B option nahi hoga kyuki 'much' adverb comparative degree ke sath use hota hai. 'Much more difficult' sahi use hua hai. Isme 'difficult' adjective ke liye 'more' adverb aayi hai jo usko comparative degree bana rahi hai aur 'much' adverb 'more' ki intensity badhane ke liye aaya hai.

questions.question: There will be little more pupils in the class next year, but we have enough space.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'Pupils' means 'Students' yeh countable noun hai isliye 'little' yaa 'much' ka use nahi hoga. sentence mein aage 'but we have enough space' se pata chal raha hai ki first wale part ka meaning dena hai ki 'kuch aur students honge next year' isliye 'a few more' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: India have a many all-rounders to match the talent and dedication of Kapil Dev.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'a many' sath nahi aa sakte isliye B option nahi hoga. 'Have' ki 'ing' form possession ke case mein use nahi hoti isliye A option nahi hoga. 'Much' adjective uncountable ke liye aata hai isliye C nahi hoga. Isliye grammar aur meaning ke according D option hi sahi hai.

questions.question: Prithvi likes baseball as long as she likes cricket.
questions.solution: Explanation:- 'likes' verb ke comparison ke liye simile mein adverb 'much' ka use hoga isliye ' as much as' sahi hai.

questions.question: When it started raining, I ran to the nearer house for shelter.
questions.solution: Explanation:- Yahan 'house' noun ke liye adjective ki requirement hai. 'Nearer' isliye nahi hoga kyunki 'than' lagake koi aisa noun nahi diya jisse comparison ho. 'near' isliye nahi hoga kyunki 'jab' near ko positive degree adjective ki tarah use karte hain to 'near nahi nearby' word ka use hota hai. isliye meaning and grammar ke according 'the nearest house' hi sahi hai.

questions.question: The less mistakes (a)/ you make in your calculations, (b)/ the more accurate your results will be. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'less' with 'fewer'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'less' ki jagah 'fewer' aayega kyunki 'less' comparative degree hoti hai 'little' ki jiska use uncountable noun ke sath hota hai, lekin 'mistakes' countable noun hai, isliye countable noun ke liye 'few' ke comparative degree 'fewer' ka use sahi hoga. Additional point - 'the' article ka use generally superlative degree ke sath hota hai, lekin comparative degree ke sath 'the' ka use do case mein hota hai. 1st gradual increase/decrease ke case mein ex. 'the higher you go, the cooler it is, the more you invest, the more you get'. Aur yeh structure question mein bhi follow ho raha hai. 2nd do logon mein se selection ki baat ho, toh comparative ke sath 'the' article ka use hota hai.

questions.question: The manager asked for (a)/ farther details (b)/ about the new marketing strategy (c)/ before approving it. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'farther' with 'further'. Explanation:- 'farther' ki jagah 'further' aayega kyunki 'farther' ka use distance ko refer karne ke liye kiya jaata hai jabki 'further' ka use more/addition ko refer karne ke liye kiya jaata hai. Toh sentence mein more/additional details ki baat karni hai, isliye 'further' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The committee agreed that this design (a)/ was most unique (b)/ among all the innovative entries submitted for the annual architecture competition. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'most' before 'unique'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'unique' ke pehle 'most' nahi ayega, kuch adjectives jaise 'impossible, eternal, supreme, entire, circular, unique, perfect, excellent etc.' yeh aise adjectives hote hai jo non gradable hote hai matlab inka comparison nahi hota, yeh khud absolute hote hai, aur unhe qualify karne ke liye 'adverb' ki jarurat nahi hoti, isliye yahan 'unique' se pehle 'most' nahi aayega. Additional point - part(c) mein 'submitted' koi verb nahi balki 'past participle' (adjective) hai 'innovative entries' ke liye, agar aage adverbial phrase likha ho toh adjective subject ke baad aa sakta hai, sentence mein 'for the annual architecture competition' yeh poora phrase 'submitted' ke liye likha hai.

questions.question: Of the four subjects, English, Mathematics, Science and History, (a)/ the latter (b)/ was the most difficult one for me. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'latter' with 'last'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'latter' ki jagah 'last' ayega kyunki jab do cheezon ki baat karni ho toh 'former, latter' ka use karte, 'former' pehle ke liye aur 'latter' baad waale ke liye, lekin jab do se jyada cheezein ho toh 'first, last' ka use karte hai, sentence mein four subject hai aur 'aakhiri' subject ke baat karni hai, isliye 'last' sahi hoga. 'last' yaa 'last one' dono likh sakte hai.

questions.question: No less than twenty buses (a)/ were lined up outside the stadium (b)/ to carry the players and the officials (c)/ back to their hotels. (d)
questions.solution: 'no less than' with 'no fewer than'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'less' ki jagah 'fewer' ayega kyunki 'less' comparative degree hoti hai 'little' ki jiska use uncountable noun ke sath hota hai, lekin 'twenty buses' countable noun hai, toh countable noun ke liye 'few' adjective ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'few' ki comparative degree 'fewer' ka use sahi hoga.

questions.question: The museum is (a)/ a worth visiting place (b)/ for those who are interested (c)/ in ancient sculptures. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'worth seeing place' with 'place worth seeing'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'worth seeing' 'place' ke baad aayega kyunki 'worth' ke sath 'ing' 'worth + ing' lagake adjective banate hai, toh wo adjective humesha 'noun' ke baad aata hai, 'place' noun hai aur 'worth seeing' adjective ki tarah kaam kar raha hai, isliye 'place worth seeing' sahi hoga. Note:- 'worth +ing' adjective wala structure yaad hee karna padega.

questions.question: Hard work, consistent practice, and (a)/ little guidance from (b)/ the mentor, especially in handling difficult situations, can (c)/ lead to great success in any field. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'little' with 'a little'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'little' ki jagah 'a little' ayega kyunki 'little' (negative meaning) ke liye aata hai jiska matlab 'naa ke barabaar' aur 'a little' (positive meaning) ke liye aata hai jiska matlab 'thoda', sentence ka matlab chaiye 'hardwork, consistent practice aur thoda sa guidance mentor se', sentence ke meaning ke according positive meaning chaiye, isliye 'a little' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Her performance was (a)/ as exciting, if (b)/ not more than her previous one. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'as exciting' with 'as exciting as'. Explanation:- Yahan 'as exciting' ki jagah 'as exciting as' aayega kyunki 'as exciting as' yahan par ek simile hai jise poora hi likha jayega. Iss sentence ka asli structure yeh hai 'her performance was as exciting as her previous one, if it is not more exciting than her previous one' yahan iska meaning yeh hai ki 'uski jo performance thi wo utni he exciting hai jitni previous one thi, agar yeh waali performance jyada exciting nahi hai usse previous one se' toh inhi dono 'performance' ka do baar comparison hai isliye 'subject + verb' understood ho rahe hai, but simile ek conjuction ka kaam karti hai yeh poori hi likhi jayegi. Isliye 'as exciting as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This solution (a)/ is superior than the previous one (b)/ if we consider not only speed (c)/ but also cost-effectiveness and long-term sustainability. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'than' with 'to'. Explanation:- Kuch adjectives jaise 'superior, inferior, prior, senior, preferable, anterior etc.' yeh aise adjectives hote hai jinke sath 'than' nahi balki 'to' preposition ka use hota hai, isliye yahan 'than' ki jagah 'to' aayega.

questions.question: He wore (a)/ the dress very designed by (b)/ his talented elder sister (c)/ for the annual school function. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'dress very' with 'very dress'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'very' 'dress' ke pehle aayega 'very' ko generally adverb bante hue dekha hai, lekin 'very' stress dene ke liye adjective ki tarah se bhi kaam karta hai, aur iska meaning 'same' jaise hota hai, yahan sentence ka matlab hai 'usne wahi dress pehni jo design kari gayi thi uski talented sister ke dwara', isliye 'very' ka use 'dress' se pehle hoga. Eg.- 'she is the very girl that stole my wallet. This is the very book'.

questions.question: Late at night, (a)/ the firefighters found an ablaze house (b)/ in the middle of the street (c)/ with flames everywhere. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'an ablaze house' with 'a house which was ablaze'. Explanation:- Kuch adjectives jaise 'ablaze, ill, well, afraid, alive etc.' yeh aise adjectives hote hai jo humesha predicatively use hote hai, matlab humesha linking verb ke baad hee use hote hai, inka use noun se pehle galat hota hai. isliye 'an ablaze house' ki jagah 'a house which was ablaze' karna padega. Sentence ka matlab hoga 'firefighters ko ek ghar mila jisme aag lagi hui thi'

questions.question: The needy (a)/ is often overlooked (b)/ by society, even though they contribute in countless ways to the community. (c)/ no error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'is' with 'are'. Explanation:- Agar 'the' ke sath qualitative adjective lag jaaye toh yeh common plural noun banata hai jaise, 'the poor, the rich, the brave' etc.' joki poori ki poori community ko represent karta hai, 'the needy' ka matlab hai 'saare jarurat mand log', kyunki yeh common plural noun banta hai isliye iske sath 'are' plural verb aayegi.

questions.question: This article says that Tamarind tastes more sourly than any other fruit in the whole world, but it is commonly used in making various Indian dishes.
options: This article says that Tamarind tastes
more sourly than any other fruit
in the whole world, but it is commonly
used in making various Indian dishes
questions.solution: replace 'more sourly' with 'sourer'. Explanation:- 'more sourly' ki jagah 'sourer' aayega kyunki 'tamarind' kuch taste nahi karegi, balki tamarind ka taste hi aisa hai, toh 'taste' yahan linking verb ki tarah se kaam kar rahi hai, aur linking verb ke baad subject complement ke roop mein adjectives aate hai, 'sourly' adverb hota hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'imli khatti hoti hai baaki other fruit se', matlab comparison karna hai jiske liye comparative degree aayegi, isliye 'more sourly' ki jagah 'sourer' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Driving on the right(a)/ is counterintuitively to the man(b)/ who has spent most(c)/ of the time driving in India(d) .
questions.solution: replace 'counterintuitively' with 'counterintuitive'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'driving' subject hai 'on' preposition aur 'right' preposition ka object, 'is' linking verb hai jiske baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, lekin 'counterintuitively' adverb hota hai aur 'counterintuitive' adjective, isliye yahan 'counterintuitive' adjective sahi hoga.

questions.question: She executed the shot known(a)/ throughout the cricket world(b) /for its complexity as good as(c)/ Dhoni did in 2009(d).
questions.solution: replace 'good' with 'well'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'usne shot execute kiya utna he badhiya tarike se jitna Dhoni ne kiya tha 2009 mein', toh sentence mein do verb ke action ka comparison ho raha hai. toh 'as....as' simile mein jab noun ka comparison karte hai, toh 'as + adjective + as' ka use karte hai, aur jab do verb ka comparison karna ho toh, 'as + adverb + as' ka use karte hai, 'good' adjective hota hai aur 'well' adverb', kyunki do action verb ka comparison karna hai, isliye 'as well as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Of the three runners who(a)/ participated in one of the biggest (b)/ marathons, he was fast(c) /No error(d).
questions.solution: replace 'fast' with 'the fastest'. Explanation:- Sentence mein teen logon ka comparison ho raha hai uss mein se ek sabse fast kehna hai, baaki sab mein se best kehne ke liye superlative degree ka use hota hai. isliye yahan 'fast' positive nahi balki 'the fastest' superlative degree ka use hoga.

questions.question: Ancient India had(a) /many people responsible(b)/ who carried out their responsibilities(c)/ through thick and thin(d).
questions.solution: replace 'people responsible' with 'responsible people'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'responsible' 'people' ke pehle aayega kyunki 'responsible' ka use noun se pehle positive meaning deta hai aur noun ke baad negative meaning deta hai. jaise 'responsible man' matlab 'jimmedar aadmi', aur 'man responsible' matlab 'kisi kaam ke liye jimmedar', toh sentence mein meaning dena hai 'jimmedar log the jinhone apni jimmedariyan nibhaayi', toh sentence mein positive meaning dena hai, isliye 'responsible people' sahi hoga.

questions.question: In a world where promises(a)/ are often made but not(b) /fulfilled, we should try to(c)/ be a true man to his word (d).
questions.solution: replace 'true man' with 'man true'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'true' 'man' ke baad aayega kyunki 'true man' ka matlab 'saccha aadmi' aur 'man true' ka matlab 'aadmi saccha hai apne words ke liye', sentence mein 'to his words' yeh phrase 'true' adjective ke liye aaya hai, agar adjective ke liye aage phrase likha ho toh adjective ko noun ke baad le jaate hai, isliye 'man true to his words' sahi hoga.

questions.question: This newly launched book contains questions(a)/ relevant to the exam but(b) /the three last have never(c)/ been seen before(d).
questions.solution: replace 'three last' with 'last three'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'three last' ki jagah 'last three' aayega kyunki 'first, second, third, last, .......' yeh ordinals hote hai, aur 'one, two, three......1, 2, 3.....' yeh cardinals hote hai, toh ordinal cardinal jab sath mein lage ho toh ordinal cardinal se pehle aate hai, isliye yahan 'last three' sahi hoga. Additional point :- isme 'relevant' adjective 'question' ke baad likha hai kyunki 'to the exam' phrase 'relevant' ke liye aaya hai, jisse matlab hai 'quesiton jo exam ke liye relevant' hai. isliye yeh part sahi hai. agar noun se pehle adjective hai aur noun ke baad adjective ke liye phrase likha ho, toh adjective noun ke baad ayega.

questions.question: The new employee whom you can see (a) /standing with our boss (b)/ is a fat big liar(c)/No error(d).
questions.solution: replace 'fat big liar' with 'big fat liar'. Explanation:- Qualitative adjective ka sequence hota hai 'opinion -> size -> age -> shape -> colour -> nationality/origin -> human emotions -> material' toh 'fat big liar' mein 'big' size pehle aayega, isliye 'big fat liar' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The new guidelines regarding the(a)/ delegation of financial power(b)/ to the head of offices have (c)/not yet been implanted despite repeating notices(d).
questions.solution: replace 'repeating notices' with 'repeated notices'. Explanation:- Sentence mein present participle vs past participle ke error hai 'repeating notices' ka matlab hoga 'repeat hote hue notice', aur 'repeated notices' ka matlab hoga 'aise notices jo baar baar bheje gaye hai', toh sentence mein 'baar baar bheje gaye notices' ka meaning dena hai, isliye yahan 'repeating' present participle nahi 'repeated' past participle sahi hoga. Eg. 'interesting novel' matlab 'romaanchak novel' aur 'interested novel' matlab 'aise novel jo interested hai'.

questions.question: Do you know that unlike the Lizard, the(a)/ rat's tail can't grow back(b)/ after it has been cut intentionally or unintentionally (c)/No error (d).
questions.solution: use 'apostrophe(s)' with 'lizard'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'lizard ki tail' ka comparison 'rat ki tail' se karna hai, lekin sentence mein 'lizard' ka comparison 'rat ki tail' se kar diya, joki meaning ke according galat hai, isliye yahan 'lizard' ke sath apostrophe 's' laga denge, jisse 'tail' understood ho jayega, do baar nahi likhana padega kyunki ek hee sentence hai, jab wo understood ho sakta hai, toh noun repeat karne ki jarurat nahi hai. isliye yahan 'lizard's' sahi hoga.

questions.question: As per this new notice, every of the employees(a)/ who came late at the boss' (b)/ last meeting will(c)/ be fined/(d).
questions.solution: replace 'each' with 'every'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'of' preposition hai 'employees' preposition ka object hai aur 'employees' noun ke liye 'who came........last meeting' yeh poora adjectival clause hai, toh 'will be fined' verb ka subject 'every' banega, lekin 'every' sirf adjective ban sakta hai aur 'each, either, neither' pronoun aur adjective dono ban sakte hai, isliye yahan 'every' adjective ko hatake 'each' pronoun ko subject banayenge, isliye 'each' yahan sahi hoga.

questions.question: I hope you know that since he is very fastidious(a)/ about almost everything, a little people(b)/ are happy with him (c)/No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'a little' with 'few'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'since he is very fastidious about almost everything' ka matlab hoga 'kyunki wo bahut hee nukssh nikaalta hai har cheez mein', agar koi nukssh nikaalne wala hoga toh 'kuch log uske sath khush nahi honge', balki 'naa ke barabaar log khush honge', sentence mein negative meaning dena hai, 'a little' ka matlab 'kuch' hota hai aur yeh uncountable cheezon ke liye use kiya jata hai, lekin 'people' toh countable noun hai, isliye 'naa ke barabar' meaning ke liye 'few' adjective sahi hoga. 'few, a few, the few' countable ke liye aur 'little, a little, the little' uncountable ke liye use kiye jate hai.

questions.question: Since he has joined the company(a)/ recently, he doesn't (b)/have some experience(c)/ regarding this task(d).
questions.solution: replace 'some' with 'any'. Explanation:- Sentence ka matlab hai 'uske pass koi experience nahi hai iss task ke liye', toh 'some' ka matlab hota hai 'kuch' aur 'any' ka matlab hota hai 'koi' aur 'negative aur interrogative' mein 'any' ko prefer karte hai aur 'koi experience' wala meaning bhi chaiye', isliye yahan 'any experience' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The NGO whose services (a)/were benefitting the(b)/ society was suddenly(c)/ closed down by the autocratic government(d).
questions.solution: replace 'whose services' with 'the services of which'. Explanation:- 'whose' relative pronoun hota hai jo ki human being pe possession banane ke liye lagaya jata hai, isliye 'NGO' ke sath 'whose' ka use galat hoga, sentence ka matlab dena hai 'wo NGO jiski services', isliye yahan 'the NGO, the services of which' likhenge. Doubt aa sakta hai ki isko 'NGO which services' likhde, lekin 'which' se possession nahi banega, isliye isse 'of which' se banake likhenge. Note:- yeh weak error ki category mein aata hai agar sentence mein koi aur error hai toh pehle wo mark hogi.

questions.question: It is the most (a)/eternal fact that we reap what (b)/ we sow whether we accept it or not (c)/No error(d).
questions.solution: remove 'most' before 'eternal'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'eternal' ke pehle 'most' nahi aayega, kuch adjectives jaise 'impossible, eternal, supreme, entire, circular, unique, perfect, excellent etc.' yeh aise adjectives hote hai jo non gradable hote hai matlab inka comparison nahi hota, yeh khud absolute hote hai, aur inhe qualify karne ke liye 'adverb' ki jarurat nahi hoti, isliye yahan 'eternal' se pehle 'most' nahi aayega.

questions.question: I can guarantee that Madhuri is wittier and wiser (a)/ than any(b)/ other boy in her class (c)/. No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'other'. Explanation:- Agar ek noun ka comparison ek group se karna ho, toh wo noun uss group ka part nahi hona chaiye, agar group ka part hai toh 'other' lagake hata dete hai, lekin sentence mein 'Madhuri' ladki ka comparison ladko ke group se karna hai, iska matlab wo ladko ke group ka part nahi hai, matlab pehle se hee alag hai, isliye 'madhuri' ko hataane ke liye 'other' lagane ki jarurat nahi hai, isliye yahan 'other' ka use nahi hoga. Note:- agar kisi ladke ka comparison hota toh 'other' nahi hatate.

questions.question: Confidence in one's (a)/abilities is crucial for(b)/ a successful business, as(c)/ it helps in building a strength foundation(d).
questions.solution: replace 'strength' with 'strong'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'foundation' aur 'strength' dono noun hai, lekin noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ki jarurat hoti hai, isliye yahan 'strength' noun nahi 'strong' adjective aayega, isliye 'strong foundation' sahi hoga jiska matlab 'majboot buniyaad'.

questions.question: The smartphones are among(a)/ the more useful(b)/ technologies that (c)/ have been invented till now.(d)
questions.solution: replace 'more' with 'most'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'more' ki jagah 'most' aayega kyunki sentence mein 'smartphones' ka abhi tak jitni bhi useful technologies aayi hai usse comparison karna hai, toh jab ek cheez ka comparison baaki sabse se karna ho toh superlative degree ka use karte hai, aur superlative degree ke liye 'most' adverb ka use hota hai. isliye 'the most useful' sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: I have made it a point to call my teachers on September 5 as a token of mine gratitude.
options: it a point to call my teachers
questions.solution: replace 'mine gratitude' with 'my gratitude'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'of' preposition hai aur 'gratitude' preposition ka object(noun) hai, toh noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ki jarurat hoti hai, lekin 'mine' toh possessive pronoun hota hai, isliye yahan 'mine' pronoun nahi balki possessive adjective 'my' aayega, isliye 'my gratitude' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I think that he sang beautifully but I don't know why the judges were unimpress at the end.
options: I think that he sang beautifully
questions.solution: replace 'unimpress' with 'unimpressed'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'judge' subject hai kyunki sentence mein koi action nahi ho raha, isliye 'were' linking verb ki tarah se kaam karega, aur linking verb ke baad subject complement ke roop mein adjective aate hai, 'unimpress' verb hoti hai aur 'unimpressed' adjective hota hai, isliye 'were unimpressed' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I have three sisters: Meera is the elder and Charu is the youngest.
questions.solution: replace 'elder' with 'eldest'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'elder' ki jagah 'eldest' aayega kyunki yahan teeno sister mein se do ke baare mein bataya hai, aur dono mein ke liye yeh kehna hai Charu sabse choti hai aur Meera sabse badi hai, beech waali sister ke liye kuch nahi bataya, toh 'Meera' ko sabse bada batane ke liye superlative degree 'eldest' ka use karenge, isliye 'the eldest' sahi hoga.

questions.question: We used to keep large plates of fruit on a table nearer this window in the dining room.
questions.solution: replace 'nearer' with 'near'. Explanation:- Sentence mein koi comparison nahi karna balki yeh kehna hai 'fruits hote the table pe window ke pass', toh 'ke pass' waale meaning ke liye 'near' positive degree adjective ka use karenge.

questions.question: Some people believe that no matter how hardly you may try, success comes to you at its own time.
options: Some people believe that no matter
to you at its own time
questions.solution: replace 'hardly' with 'hard'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'hardly' ki jagah 'hard' aayega kyunki 'hardly' ka matlab 'naa ke barabar' hota hai, sentence mein matlab dena hai 'chahe tum kitni bhi koshish/mehnat karlo', toh 'koshish, tough, hard' waale meaning ke liye yahan par 'hard' adverb sahi hoga.

questions.question: Venus, the hottest planet in the solar system, has not enjoyed as much as recent attention as Mars.
options: as much as recent attention as Mars.
Venus, the hottest planet in the solar
questions.solution: remove 'as' in between 'much' and 'recent attention'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'Venus' aur 'Mars' ke beech mein 'recent attention' ko leke baat karni hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'Venus ko utni attention nahi mili jitni mars ko', agar 'as much as' likh denge toh yeh pata nahi chalega kiska comparison ho raha hai, yahan comparison 'recent attention' noun ka karna hai, isliye noun ko simile mein daalna padega. agar noun ko simile ke beech mein daalna hai toh uska structure 'as + adverb/adjective + noun + as' hota hai. Matlab simile mein baad wala 'as' noun ke baad likha jata hai, isliye 'as much recent attention as' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You should not be that (a)/cynical. Mr. Surya has no interior motive (b)/ in offering you support. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'interior' with 'ulterior'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'interior' ki jagah 'ulterior' aayega kyunki sentence ka matlab hai 'aapko itna bhi sandeh nahi karna chaiye ki Surya ka koi galat motive nahi hai tumhe support karna mein'. 'ulterior' ka matlab hota hai 'kis baat ko kehne yaa karne ke picche chupa hua matlab yaa irada', 'interior' ka matlab 'andhruni', toh sentence ke meaning ke according 'ulterior motive' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I could not believe that (a)/ Ajay got into a fight with those (b)/ thugs. I always thought (c)/that he is smarter than brave. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'smarter' with 'more smart'. Explanation:- Agar sentence mein ek hee person ki do qualities ka aapas mein comparison karna ho toh 'er' wala structure nahi balki 'more' wala structure use hota hai, sentence ka matlab hai 'wo jyada smart hai brave hone se', isliye yahan 'more smart' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You can emphasize either of these four syllables in the poem written by Shakespeare who is also known as the Kalidasa of England.
questions.solution: correct answer is 'emphasize any of these'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'four syllables' ki baat ho rahi hai, lekin 'either, neither' ka use do cheezon ke liye hota hai, aur 'more than two' ke liye 'any, each' ka use hota hai, isliye diye gaye options mein se 'emphasize any of these' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The Japanese people are known for their commitment toward the nation and praised for their efficiency .
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'The Japanese'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'Japan ke logon' ki baat karni hai, toh 'The Japanese' ka matlab hee hota hai 'Japan ke log', aur 'The Japanese' aur 'The Japanese people' mein koi difference nahi hai dono ka matlab ek hai, lekin sentence improvement mein agar ek hee baat kehne ka koi aur chota tarika hai toh usse prefer karte hai, options mein bhi 'The Japanese' chhota option available hai, isliye 'The Japanese' option B sahi hoga. Note:- agar yeh question error mein aata toh 'no error' mark karte, lekin sentence improvement ka matlab he hai usse improve karna.

questions.question: The student responded to the question so logically that the audience praised his analytic approach repeatedly despite the time constraints.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'analytical approach repeatedly'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'approach' noun hai aur noun ko qualify karne ke liye adjective ki jarurat hoti hai 'analytic' bhi adjective hota hai lekin yeh cheezon ke liye lagta hai. Person ke liye 'analytical' adjective ka use karte hai, isliye sahi word yahan 'analytical approach' hoga, isliye option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: This shirt which is newly launched in the market cost me five thousand rupee
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'cost me five thousand rupee'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'cost' verb hai jiski 'v1, v2, v3' form same hoti hai, isliye 'costed' wala option B galat hoga. Ab yeh shirt khareedne wala action habitual action nahi hai, isliye isse 'costs' present indefinite mein nahi likhenge, isliye option A bhi galat hoga. Sentence mein 'paanch hazaar rupay' ki baat karni hai jisme 'rupees' noun ke liye 'five thousand' adjective ki tarah se kaam kar raha hai, aur adjective ka plural nahi ho sakta, isliye 'five thousands rupees' wala option C bhi galat hoga, aur 'five thousand rupees' wala option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Of the two plans submitted by the architect, this is the one much likely to be accepted.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'more likely'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'architect ke dwara submit kare gaye 2 plan mein se accept karna hai', matlab yahan comparison karna, isliye yahan comparative degree 'more likely' wala option B sahi hoga. Note:- 'than' yahan understood hai kyunki pehle he likh diya kis kiska comparison hona hai.

questions.question: Prashant is good from more other players of our school who participated in the All India Cricket Championship League.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'better than most other'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'Prashant' ka comparison baaki players se karna hai, isliya positive degree 'good' ka use galat hoga, isliye option A aur D galat honge. 'best' ke baad 'than' ka use galat hota hai, agar 'of' preposition lagake 'best of the players' likhte toh sahi ho jata, lekin 'best' ke baad 'than' laga hai, isliye option B bhi galat hoga. Option C sahi hoga jisse matlab hoga 'Prashant better hai jyadatar baaki players se', aur yahan comparative degree ka use sahi hai, isliye 'better than most other' wala option C sahi hoga. Note:- 'most' yahan superlative wala nahi balki 'jyadatar' waale meaning ke liye hai.

questions.question: Please tell me if you also think that no bird is more taller than a ostrich.
options: no bird is much taller than an ostrich
no other bird is as tall as an ostrich
no bird is taller than ostrich
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'no other bird is as tall as an ostrich'. Explanation:- Jab ek noun ka comparison ek group se karna ho, aur wo noun uss group ka part ho, toh usse 'other' lagake hatate hai, kyunki 'ostrich' bhi ek bird hai, isliye isse 'birds' waale group se 'other' lagake hatana padega. Option A, D aur C mein 'taller' comparative degree toh lagi hai, lekin 'ostrich' ko bird waale group se exclude nahi kiya, isliye yeh options galat honge. Sirf option B mein 'other' lagake exclude kiya hai aur grammar aur meaning wise bhi sahi hai, isliye 'no other bird is as tall as an ostrich' wala option B sahi hoga. Note:- simile ka option B jaise structure banake comparison kiya jaa sakte hai.

questions.question: A renowned chemist claimed that taking up to 50 times the commendable dose of vitamin-c could treat anything from influenza to cancer.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'recommended'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'dose' noun hai aur isse pehle adjective ki jarurat hai. 'precribe' toh verb hoti hai, isliye yeh galat hoga. 'vounched' ka matlab hota hai 'kisi ke character wagera ki guarantee lena'. 'commended' ka matlab 'kisi ki tareef karna'. 'recommended' ka matlab 'salaah'. Toh meaning ke according 'recommended' sahi hoga, 'recommended dose' ka matlab hoga 'aisa dose jiski salaah di gayi ho'.

questions.question: When I was in Europe last year, I used to roam around in London on alternate days.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'no improvement'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'days' noun hai 'alternative' bhi noun hota hai, isliye option B galat hoga. 'alternate days' ka matlab 'ek din chhodke ek din'. Toh meaning ke according 'alternate days' he sahi hai, isliye no improvement hoga. 'day by day' habitual action ko dikhaata hai, aur 'day after day' ke liye 'alternate' word hota hai aur isse chhota, concise, better hai, toh isse change nahi karenge, isliye 'no improvement' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The prime minister's speech laid out how important it is to encourage female participate in the economy yet the percentage of female lawmakers in the lower house of the parliament has fallen to 8%
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'female participation'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'to encourage' infinitive jiska object 'female participate' banega, lekin 'participate' toh verb hota hai aur object 'noun yaa pronoun' bante hai, isliye yahan 'participation' noun sahi hoga. Jisme 'female' 'participation' ka adjective banega, isliye 'female participation' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He claimed that he was merely an uninterested participant in the negotiation held by senior officers.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'a disinterested'. Explanation:- 'uninterested' ka matlab 'jiska kisi cheez mein interest nahi ho' aur 'disinterested' ka matlab 'baised naa hona (pakshpaat nahi karna)', sentence ka matlab hai 'usne kaha wo ek participants hai negotiations mein jo held kari gayi senior officers ke dwara', toh sentence ka matlab hai 'wo biased nahi hai iss negotiation mein', toh meaning ke according 'a disinterested' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He has told me that of Rajni and Usha, the later is the most responsible.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'the latter is more'. Explanation:- 'later' baad ke 'time' ke liye use hota hai, jab do cheezon mein se baad waale ke liye kehna ho, toh 'latter' ka use karte hai, aur 'Rajni aur Usha' mein se comparison karna hai, isliye 'more' comparative degree sahi hogi, isliye 'the latter is more' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: 50 Chinese couples were married at a ceremony in Colombo to mark the anniversary of (diplomat relations between the two countries).
options: Diplomatic relations among the two countries
Diplomatic relations between the two countries
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'diplomatic relations between the two countries'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'relations' noun aur isse pehle adjective ki jarurat hai, lekin 'diplomat' toh khud noun hota hai, isliye yeh galat hoga, iski jagah 'diplomatic' adjective aayega. Aur do countries ki baat karni hai, isliye 'between the two countries' sahi hoga, isliye diplomatic relations between the two countries' wala option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The people living in the coastal areas experience a interested phenomenon.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'an interesting phenomenon'. Explanation:- 'interested phenomenon' ka matlab hoga 'aisa phenomenon jo interested ho', aur 'interesting phenomenon' ka matlab 'aisa phenomenon jo interesting ho', sentence ka matlab 'jo log coastal area mein rehte hai wo experience karte hai interesting phenomenon ko', toh yahan 'phenomenon' 'interesting' hone ka doer hai, isliye yahan present participle 'an interesting phenomenon' sahi hoga.

questions.question: Among all the novels I have read in the past year, this one is far the most engaging.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'by far the most engaging'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'ek novel' ka comparison baaki jitni bhi usne padhi hai usse karna hai, jab ek ka comparison baaki sabse ho toh superlative degree ka use karte hai, aur superlative degree ki intensity badhaani ho, toh superlative degree ke sath 'by far, much' ka use karte hai, isliye 'by far the most engaging' wala option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: The branches of the old mango tree were _______ heavy ripe, golden mangoes.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'laden with'. Explanation:- 'loaded' ka use tab karte hai 'jab koi cheez uski limit tak bhari ho', aur 'laden' ka use 'koi cheez ek limit se jyada bhari ho', bahut jagah 'loaded' aur 'laden' dono sahi hote hai. Lekin Trees pe lage fruits ke liye aur person pe emotion burden yaa responsibilities etc ke liye 'loaded' nahi 'laden' ka use hota hai. isliye yahan 'laden with' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Despite its simple appearance, this grammar book is arguably_______resource I've encountered.
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'the most effective'. Explanation:- Sentence mein 'I've encountered' se pata chal raha ki aaj tak usne jitni bhi grammar ki kitab padhi usme yeh waali acchi hai, toh ek ka comparison baaki sab se karna ho toh superlative degree ka use karte hai, isliye 'the most effective' wala option C sahi hoga.
